paper_title: Search for Axions in Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization at Lick and Keck Observatories
notes: Headline: |g_agamma| <~ 1.7e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a <~ 2e-7 eV, from photon-to-axion conversion in the strong magnetic field of magnetic white dwarfs inducing linear polarization; no dark-matter assumption is made (so no density rescaling / dm_density null). Curve is the most-constraining MWD, J033320+000720 (Lick), the red line in Fig.1, extracted from the e-print vector file plots/limit_summary.pdf (red-stroke drawing idx128). Axis calibration from tick labels: x log10(m/eV)=-14+(px-140.2)/93; y log10(g)=-13+(669.5-px)/217.43; flat value recovers 1.694e-12 = paper's 1.7e-12. Limit is flat at ~1.7e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a from <1e-14 eV up to ~1e-7 eV, then rises for m_a > 2e-7 eV as photon-axion dispersion suppresses conversion; last point (4e-6, 1.2e-10) is where the rising curve exits the top-right of the plot frame. Coupling convention L = g_agamma a E.B matches canonical. 95% one-sided CL.
